content.tex: INVESTIGATION ISOSCELES TRAPEZIUMS
This investigation looks at the perimeter of isosceles trapeziums drawn on 1cm isometric grids and the number of unit equilateral triangles in these trapeziums.
There is a spare isometric grid on page 12.
